concept: Socio - Religious Reform Movements in the 19th and 20th CE India
question: When was Dev Samaj established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1887**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dev Samaj was established in the year **1887**.
 
• It is a religious and social reform organization founded by **Shiv Narayan Agnihotri**.
 
• The primary objective of Dev Samaj is to promote **moral and social upliftment**.
 
• Dev Samaj emphasizes the importance of **truth, love, and justice** in human life.
 
• The organization also focuses on **education and women's empowerment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brahmo Samaj**

 
 
• Founded in 1828 by Raja Ram Mohan Roy.
 
• Aimed at reforming the social and religious practices in India.
 
• Promoted monotheism and the abandonment of idol worship.
 
 
 
• **Arya Samaj**
 
 
• Founded by Swami Dayananda Saraswati in 1875.
 
• Focused on the revival of Vedic ideologies and practices.
 
• Promoted the idea of universal brotherhood and social reform.
 
 
 
• **Prarthana Samaj**
 
 
• Founded in 1867 in Bombay (now Mumbai).
 
• Focused on social reform and promoted the values of the Bhakti movement.
 
• Emphasized the importance of education and the abolition of caste discrimination.
